expected_safe_actions: Measure dissolved oxygen promptly, then test ammonia, nitrite, pH and temperature before drawing a disease conclusion.
Observe the affected fish closely and record appetite, behaviour, visible signs and mortality.
Review aeration, filtration, feeding, recent handling, stocking changes and fish introductions.
Provide clear photographs and contact a fish-health professional if signs persist, spread or become more specific.
expected_escalation: Seek urgent help if fish begin gasping, lose balance, develop severe lesions or eye abnormalities, or if mortality starts or rises rapidly.
expected_confirmation: Collect the missing water-quality and history information and perform a fish-health examination before ranking infectious or environmental causes; laboratory testing should be selected only if later findings support it.
